problems.problem: Handling custom quote submissions and project drawings through generic web forms can lead to slow turnaround times without an automated estimating intake queue.
problems.label: hypothesis
problems.basis: The site uses Contact Form 7 with image/drawing uploads up to 16MB; unautomated back-office review of unstructured specs often introduces quoting delays.

problems.problem: Leads submitted online may require manual entry into shop management or accounting systems.
problems.label: hypothesis
problems.basis: Standard Contact Form 7 configurations email lead details rather than integrating directly with manufacturing ERP or job-shop software.

existingSolutions.solution: Job shop ERP/quoting software (e.g., JobBOSS, ECI M1, or ProShop)
existingSolutions.addresses: Estimating, drawing review, machine scheduling, and job costing for custom manufacturing shops.

existingSolutions.solution: Webhook-based CRM integration (e.g., Zapier connecting Contact Form 7 to an internal CRM)
existingSolutions.addresses: Instant lead notifications, acknowledgment emails, and automated CRM record creation.

feasibility.explanation: Not applicable because Boise Metal Works is outside ForgeX's defined target customer segment, so no ForgeX automation services are recommended.

aiDelivery.explanation: Not applicable because no ForgeX solutions are proposed.

humanReview: Confirm disqualification based on industry mismatch (custom metal fabrication vs. HVAC/plumbing/electrical).

risks.description: Engaging outside the HVAC, plumbing, and electrical trade segment creates mismatch risks, as custom metal fabrication requires engineering drawings, machine capacity scheduling, and custom manufacturing ERP workflows rather than residential field-service dispatch pipelines.

questions: How are custom fabrication quote requests and CAD/drawing uploads from your website routed to your estimating team?
What shop management or ERP software do you use to track jobs from initial quote to final delivery?

sourcesUsed.usedFor: Business identification, primary address, phone number, service overview, and website technology analysis.
Company founding history and operational background.
Contact channels, geographic service area, and quote form upload mechanics.
Core service offerings and trade categorization.
Shop hourly rates ($95/hr), material capabilities, and fabrication specifications.
Shop equipment, CNC machining, welding, and water jet capacities.

limitations: No public email addresses are published on the website.
No current executive, owner, or manager titles are explicitly designated for active personnel; only historical founders from 1994 are referenced.
Employee headcount, revenue figures, and internal software systems are not published on the site.

qualification.rationale: ForgeX targets owner-led home-service contractors in HVAC, plumbing, and electrical with 10 to 75 staff who pay for leads. Boise Metal Works is a custom metal fabrication, CNC machining, and industrial manufacturing facility producing architectural steel, truck upfits, and industrial tanks. It does not operate in the HVAC, plumbing, or electrical trades, placing it entirely outside ForgeX's commercial target segment.
